descriptions.job-018rsws:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

We’re looking for a Director & Associate General Counsel, Banking and Credit Cards, to join our Legal team. This role is a key part of Robinhood’s legal leadership and will function as a hands-on legal advisor while also managing a small team of attorneys. The ideal candidate will serve as a strategic partner to our Banking and Credit Card business, and work cross-functionally with Robinhood’s other regulated businesses.

This is a high-impact role for a legal leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can think across multiple regulatory frameworks, and is passionate about building and mentoring legal talent.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, or Washington, DC office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Lead and manage a team of attorneys supporting Robinhood’s Banking and Credit Card business.
  • Provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice to cross-functional teams on a broad range of regulatory issues affecting banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit cards.
  • Partner closely with compliance, product, operations, and executive leadership to identify legal risks and drive mitigation strategies.
  • Support regulatory engagement and examinations as needed.
  • Help build scalable legal processes, frameworks and controls to support a rapidly evolving financial technology company.
  • Mentor and grow team members while promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, and inclusion.

What you bring

  • J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar in good standing.
  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a strong background in consumer financial regulatory law, including, for example, banking, deposit accounts, payments, and credit.
  • Experience managing legal professionals or cross-functional teams, with a track record of developing talent and delivering results.
  • Ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory issues while delivering clear, risk-based, actionable guidance.
  • Experience advising business and product teams on compliance with Truth in Lending Act (Reg Z), Truth in Savings Act (Reg DD), Electronic Fund Transfer Act (Reg E), Fair Credit Reporting Act (Reg V), Equal Opportunity Credit Act (Reg B), UDAAP under Dodd-Frank and UDAP under FTC Act,  payment network rules (including NACHA and card networks), TCPA and CAN-SPAM, Expedited Funds Availability Act (Reg CC), Bank Secrecy Act/AML/OFAC Sanctions, laws governing rewards programs, and laws governing first- and third-party collections, including the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (Reg F).
  • Experience advising business and product teams on legal issues affecting fintech-bank partnerships, including state licensing (lending, marketing, brokering, servicing, collections), usury, interest exportation, and contractual obligations under governing program and sponsorship agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth, and highly regulated environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a business-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly develop fluency in new substantive areas and effectively lead and collaborate with team members who bring deep subject-matter expertise.

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$278,000—$327,000 USD
Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$245,000—$288,000 USD
Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$217,000—$255,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
descriptions.job-0476nh8:
About the Company

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

The role

We're hiring a Product Compliance Manager to make sure every product Rain ships is compliant by design. You'll sit between Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, turning regulations and card network rules into clear product requirements before code is written, not after launch.

Rain moves fast: partners go live in weeks, and new products like embedded wallets, credit and prepaid programs, and agent-issued virtual cards keep coming. You'll own the compliance review that lets that speed hold up with regulators, the networks, our bank partners and auditors.

What you'll do

  • Own product compliance reviews. Assess new products, features and partner programs end to end, from PRD to launch, and sign off on the compliance requirements each one needs.

  • Translate rules into requirements. Turn regulations and network rules into concrete specs, controls and acceptance criteria that Product and Engineering can build against.

  • Keep card programs network-compliant. Own adherence to Visa and Mastercard operating rules as a Principal Member, including program approvals, network registrations and periodic attestations.

  • Cover consumer protection. Apply Reg E, Reg Z, TILA, UDAAP, ECOA and state requirements to cardholder agreements, disclosures, fees, rewards and dispute flows.

  • Review partner programs. Assess partner use cases, marketing materials, cardholder terms and onboarding flows before launch, and monitor them after.

  • Partner with Financial Crimes. Make sure KYC/KYB, sanctions screening and transaction monitoring requirements are built into products such as wallets, payouts, onramps and offramps.

  • Track the landscape. Follow stablecoin, payments and money transmission developments in the US and abroad, including federal stablecoin rules and MiCA, and flag what changes our roadmap.

  • Build the program. Maintain product compliance policies, the review process, a product risk inventory and the evidence trail that bank partners, networks, regulators and auditors ask for.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product compliance, regulatory compliance or a similar role at a fintech, card issuer, program manager, sponsor bank or payments company.

  • Hands-on knowledge of card issuing: Visa and/or Mastercard operating rules, prepaid and credit programs, and the issuer–processor–program manager model.

  • Working knowledge of US consumer financial regulation, including Reg E, Reg Z, UDAAP and state money transmission rules.

  • A track record of reviewing products before launch and writing requirements that engineers actually build from.

  • Sound judgment on risk: you know when to say "yes, if" and when to say no, and you can explain both.

  • Clear writing for very different readers, from an engineer's ticket to a bank partner's due diligence questionnaire.

Nice to have, but not mandatory

  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets or crypto-linked card programs.

  • Exposure to international regimes such as MiCA, UK FCA rules or APAC payments licensing.

  • Background at a Principal Member issuer or sponsor bank, including network audits or bank partner exams.

  • Familiarity with BSA/AML, OFAC and FinCEN requirements.

  • A JD or a certification such as CAMS or CRCM.

  • Comfort reading API docs and working inside tools like Linear, Jira or Notion.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy, and happy experience at Rain:

  • Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take at least 10 days off.

  • Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace. If you feel comfortable at home, please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office, feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will receive a stipend to create a comfortable home environment.

  • Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

  • Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

  • Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmaker an equity option plan so we can all benefit from our success.

  • Rain Cards 🌧️ We want Rainmakers to be knowledgeable about our core products and services. To support this mission, we issue a card for our team to use for testing.

  • Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers are welcome to use their card for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

  • Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company off-sites both domestically and internationally.

About us
 
Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?
 
We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.
 
Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally
 
Our culture
 
We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.
 
We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.
 
We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.
 
We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.

We’re looking for a social-first creative who’s confident on camera and knows how to make content people want to watch and share.

You’ll pitch ideas, jump on relevant trends, and take content from concept through filming and an initial edit, with support from our video team to refine and enhance the final output. From quick explainers and interviews to event coverage and recurring video series, you’ll help give Aave Labs a distinctive voice and presence on social.

You should be naturally curious, plugged into internet culture, and comfortable bringing your own personality to the screen. An interest in finance, fintech, or crypto is a plus.

    •

Aave Labs celebrates diversity and views each and every team member as a separate individual with their own unique identity. Role Overview
We are looking for a Singapore-based Compliance Manager to support a licensed cross-border payments business as it strengthens its compliance framework and prepares for future business expansion.
 
The role will work closely with management and external advisers on regulatory matters, AML/CFT, governance, regulatory submissions, and the review of new payment products, corridors and partnerships.
 
This is a hands-on role suited to someone who understands Singapore's payments regulatory environment and can translate regulatory requirements into practical operating processes.
Role Overview
We are looking for a Singapore-based Compliance Manager to support a licensed cross-border payments business as it strengthens its compliance framework and prepares for future business expansion.
 
The role will work closely with management and external advisers on regulatory matters, AML/CFT, governance, regulatory submissions, and the review of new payment products, corridors and partnerships.
 
This is a hands-on role suited to someone who understands Singapore's payments regulatory environment and can translate regulatory requirements into practical operating processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day compliance matters for a Singapore-regulated cross-border payments business.
  • Support regulatory submissions, notifications, licence-related matters and ongoing engagement with MAS.
  • Review new products, payment flows, customer segments, corridors and counterparties from a regulatory and compliance perspective.
  • Maintain and strengthen AML/CFT, KYC/KYB, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and related controls.
  • Support the development and updating of compliance policies, procedures and internal controls.
  • Advise management on regulatory requirements under the Payment Services Act and related MAS requirements.
  • Work with business, operations, legal and product teams to ensure new initiatives are structured and implemented appropriately.
  • Support regulatory inspections, information requests, audits and remediation work where required.
  • Monitor regulatory developments relevant to payments, remittance and cross-border money transfer.
  • Help ensure the company's compliance framework remains appropriate as its transaction volumes, customer base and business complexity increase.

Preferred Profile

  • Experience in payments, remittance, fintech, financial institutions or another regulated financial-services environment in Singapore.
  • Good understanding of the Payment Services Act, AML/CFT requirements and MAS regulatory expectations.
  • Experience relevant to cross-border payments, money transfer, payment institutions, AML/CFT, licensing, supervision or regulatory compliance would be particularly valuable.
  • Experience supporting regulatory applications, material-change submissions, inspections or regulatory engagement is advantageous.
  • Able to interpret regulatory requirements and convert them into workable business processes and controls.
  • Comfortable working in a lean environment and taking ownership of practical execution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to work directly with senior management and external legal/compliance advisers.
descriptions.job-0ru2duk:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Role Overview

Own customer-facing project management from lease execution through Ready for Service (RFS), serving as the central link among the customer, Hut 8 Commercialization, Asset Management, Engineering and Construction, and the general contractor. The role covers the development, construction, commissioning, and delivery period; at RFS and project closeout, customer and site responsibility transitions to Asset Management.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the customer's primary point of contact for all design, engineering, construction, commissioning, and delivery matters through RFS.
  • Act as the day-to-day integrator across the customer, internal Hut 8 teams, and the general contractor.
  • Maintain ground-level knowledge of the project — design development, construction sequencing, RFIs, submittals, schedule dependencies, open issues, and change orders — by working directly with Hut 8 and contractor engineering and construction teams.
  • Own customer-initiated change requests end to end: intake, clarification, technical scoping, internal coordination, cost and schedule impact assessment, pricing, customer approval, implementation tracking, and closeout.
  • Evaluate and communicate the downstream effects of proposed changes on cost, schedule, design, procurement, commissioning, and contractual commitments.
  • Ensure change orders and customer requests follow the processes established under applicable EPC, general contractor, engineering, and lease arrangements; escalate deviations to the appropriate internal owner.
  • Translate customer requirements into clear direction for internal and contractor teams, and translate technical and schedule information into clear updates for the customer and Commercialization team.
  • Provide the customer with regular, accurate updates on design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, schedule, open decisions, and risks.
  • Prepare for and lead recurring customer project meetings, maintaining action logs, decision records, and issue trackers with accountability for follow-ups.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for customer requests, project commitments, lease-driven delivery obligations, amendments, change-order history, approvals, and communications.
  • Identify and escalate issues that could affect RFS, customer expectations, commercial terms, project economics, or long-term operability of the asset.
  • Coordinate project closeout and formal handoff to Asset Management at RFS, including final change-order documentation, delivery of project records, confirmation of open items, and transfer of customer, contractual, and operational history.
  • Following handoff, transition to the next development or construction-stage customer project.

ABOUT YOU

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in project management, construction management, owner's representation, or customer delivery, including direct experience within data center environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of EPC and general contractor processes, including design development, RFIs, submittals, procurement, construction sequencing, commissioning, change management, and project closeout.
  • Able to work in the details with engineering and construction teams while communicating clearly with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience assessing and communicating the cost, schedule, technical, contractual, and operational impacts of proposed project changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage key customer stakeholders and translate between technical and commercial audiences.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple decisions, timelines, approvals, and work-streams across one or more active projects.
  • Proactive in identifying risks early, driving cross-functional resolution, and maintaining accountability across internal and external teams.
  • Familiarity with data center leases, EPC agreements, construction contracts, and change orders strongly preferred.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

descriptions.job-0g0iie4:
The Deal Desk function partners across Chainalysis to help teams structure and execute complex commercial deals. For APAC, this role will provide dedicated regional coverage across markets including ASEAN, Korea, Japan and Australia, helping Sales teams get timely support in their time zone.

Combining commercial judgment with analytical rigor, the team develops solutions that meet customer needs while aligning with Chainalysis’ pricing, product and contractual guidelines. Deal complexity is increasing as the function provides more structuring guidance and the company evolves toward consumption-based pricing.

You’ll join a growing, decentralized function and work closely with APAC Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing and other teams. You’ll receive support from colleagues in other regions as you ramp, then take increasing ownership of regional deal support and make well-reasoned decisions within established guardrails.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with APAC Sales to structure, price and quote complex deals, applying your understanding of our licensing, subscription and consumption based pricing models to recommend solutions that meet customer needs and align with company guidelines.

  • Review deal requests, analyze pricing and discounts, and present clear recommendations to business approvers.

  • Guide Sales through negotiations, contract objections, alternative deal structures and non-standard order-form requirements.

  • Work with Legal, Product, Finance, Revenue Operations and other teams to resolve complex commercial issues and support accurate forecasting and order booking.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for APAC Sales on pricing, quoting and exceptions to standard processes, providing timely support across regional time zones.

  • Help Sales leaders prioritize opportunities around month-end, quarter-end and year-end deadlines.

  • Apply sound commercial judgment and clearly explain recommendations, risks and trade-offs.

  • Troubleshoot complex quoting issues in Salesforce CPQ or similar systems, and share recurring deal insights with the team.

  • Identify and deliver improvements to workflows, documentation and system automation.

  • Build expertise in consumption-based pricing as Chainalysis’ commercial models evolve.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

  • Experience in the technology industry, ideally in RevOps, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, business partnering, order management or a related function supporting Sales teams.

  • Familiarity with SaaS subscription pricing and the ability to understand how commercial terms and pricing structures support customer needs and company objectives.

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and Salesforce CPQ, or similar quoting systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, including pricing, discount and commercial analysis.

  • Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities.

  • The ability to make and explain reasoned decisions at the appropriate level, without needing to escalate every issue.

  • Comfort working independently in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity, changing priorities and time-sensitive requests.

  • Strong organizational and workload-management skills, with the ability to prioritize based on risk and business needs.

  • A strategic, adaptable and growth-oriented mindset, with the potential to take on increasing ownership over time.

  • Proven ability to work effectively with stakeholders across APAC markets and different working styles.

  • Working with APAC teams or navigating regional differences in stakeholder needs and ways of working.

  • We value potential, strategic thinking and adaptability alongside relevant experience. Direct Deal Desk experience is helpful, but experience supporting Sales through RevOps, Sales Operations, business partnering or order management can also be relevant.

Nice to have experience:

  • Supporting Sales teams with consumption-based pricing models.

  • Structuring or reviewing commercial deals, including basic deal-desk or order-management experience.

  • Supporting sales to crypto exchanges, fintech companies or payment providers.

  • Working with both SaaS and on-premise commercial models.

  • Developing pricing frameworks, approval processes or scalable Deal Desk operations.

  • Knowledge of revenue recognition principles, including GAAP and ASC 606.

  • Working with a consumption-based CPQ platform.

  • Partnering with IT or Business Systems teams on Salesforce enhancements and automation.

  • Experience in crypto or blockchain; this is a plus, not a requirement.


Technologies we use:

  • Salesforce

  • Salesforce CPQ

  • Slack

  • Google Workspace

  • Microsoft Office

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

descriptions.job-184l3h8:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Tax Transfer Pricing team designs, implements, and defends the intercompany pricing policies that support Stripe’s global operating model, ensuring pricing between Stripe entities is compliant, defensible, and aligned with how the business creates value.

As Stripe expands its product portfolio and international footprint, our transfer pricing policies and documentation must evolve alongside the business. Transactions between Stripe affiliates are becoming increasingly complex and, in some cases, share characteristics with transactions commonly undertaken by financial services institutions. These arrangements, including those supporting Stripe’s stablecoin-related activities, may also be subject to scrutiny from regulators that oversee the financial services sector. We are seeking an experienced Transfer Pricing Specialist with financial services expertise to help develop practical, scalable transfer pricing policies, work through the tax and regulatory considerations relevant to intercompany arrangements, and provide subject matter expertise in audit defense and dispute resolution.

What you’ll do

The Financial Services Transfer Pricing Strategist will be a hands-on, collaborative member of the team responsible for developing and implementing compliant, practical transfer pricing policies and processes. The role will focus on transactions between Stripe’s legal entities that have characteristics commonly associated with the financial services sector, including intercompany arrangements supporting Stripe’s stablecoin-related activities.

This individual will work closely with teams across the organization and must be an excellent communicator who can explain complex transfer pricing concepts clearly to non-tax audiences. The ideal candidate will have transfer pricing experience in payments, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment, as well as a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional teams and other members of the tax organization.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with teams within and outside of Finance to develop, execute, and maintain transfer pricing policies for Stripe’s current and future operating structure and product offerings with a strong moral compass and integrity
  • Analyze financial information to design, prepare, and review detailed calculations, assist in preparing legal entity forecasts, and support the tax provision process
  • Address the transfer pricing impacts of special projects related to restructurings, acquisitions, and corporate initiatives, and ensure operating models are fit for purpose in the context of evolving global tax and transfer pricing frameworks and other regulations that apply to transactions between affiliates
  • Build relationships with product and business leaders to understand their organizational structure and activities, and adapt transfer pricing policies in response to changes
  • Assist finance, legal, and tax teams in government and regulatory audits, and support Stripe’s participation in tax audits, advance pricing agreements, and competent authority proceedings
  • Prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation and compliance in accordance with Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) guidelines and local tax and regulatory requirements, ensuring efficiency and quality across a subset of assigned jurisdictions
  • Build or simplify transfer pricing models for clarity, efficiency, and ease of use

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting, economics, business, law, or a related field, and 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong knowledge of global transfer pricing laws and regulations, experience with international tax planning for a multinational, and experience in financial services, banking, fintech, payments, or another regulated industry
  • Experience managing transfer pricing documentation and compliance; practical experience with transfer pricing dispute resolution, including audits, advance pricing agreement negotiations, and competent authority negotiations; and experience developing, maintaining, and implementing intercompany agreements
  • Knowledge of financial accounting concepts, including accounting for intercompany transactions; professional experience with Excel, Oracle, and Smart View; and enjoyment of working with and digging into data from multiple sources
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, strong interpersonal and team-building capabilities across different functional areas and cultures, and curiosity, empathy, and humility

Preferred qualifications

  • An advanced degree or professional qualification in tax, accounting, economics, or law, such as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential, Juris Doctor (JD), or Master of Laws (LLM)
  • Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment
  • Working knowledge of Regulation W, Sections 23A and 23B of the Federal Reserve Act, or comparable affiliate transaction requirements, including pricing, documentation, governance, or monitoring considerations, with a practical understanding of how regulatory requirements affect operating models and affiliate arrangements
  • Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, wallets, on-chain financial infrastructure, payments, or treasury products

descriptions.job-0de85zw:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Lead transaction monitoring optimization, including rule testing, threshold tuning, and the design and rollout of new monitoring scenarios to improve detection quality and reduce false positives

  • Identify and drive automation and workflow improvements across FIU processes to increase operational efficiency and effectiveness

  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including LLM and AI-enabled tools, to enhance alert triage, investigations, SAR filing and FIU operational capabilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to support vendor integrations, monitoring infrastructure improvements, and FIU tooling enhancements

  • Collaborate with Compliance leadership, including RCOs and MLROs, to maintain well-governed transaction monitoring frameworks aligned with regulatory expectations

  • Support FIU scalability by designing processes and monitoring strategies that enable expansion into new products, regions, and increased transaction volumes

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in AML, financial crime compliance, or FIU operations, with deep knowledge of transaction monitoring frameworks, suspicious activity detection, and regulatory expectations under BSA/AML regimes

  • 3+ years of experience designing, testing, and tuning transaction monitoring rules, including threshold optimization, scenario design, and alert reduction strategies

  • 3+ years of experience working with transaction monitoring systems and compliance tooling, including case management platforms, monitoring infrastructure, and investigative workflows

  • Experience working in a regulated financial institution, preferably one licensed to operate in the EU, UK, and/or United States

  • Experience driving process optimization or automation initiatives within compliance or financial crime programs to improve operational efficiency and scalability

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, or Operations teams to implement monitoring controls, vendor integrations, or compliance technology solutions

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills, with experience using metrics, dashboards, and data analysis to evaluate monitoring effectiveness and improve detection quality

  • Experience operating in fast-growing fintech, payments, or crypto environments, with the ability to design scalable compliance controls that support new product launches and geographic expansion

  • Experience working with AI, machine learning, or LLM-enabled compliance tools, including investigative automation or alert triage technologies

  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar crypto investigative platforms

  • Experience supporting vendor selection, implementation, or integration of regtech solutions

 
 

Nice to haves

  • ACAMS, CAMS-Audit, CFCS, or similar financial crime certifications

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for:


The Senior IT Systems Administrator is a key, hands-on role based onsite at Circle's New York City office, Monday through Friday, full-time. You will maintain and improve our Mac environment, office network (Cisco Meraki), and audio-visual systems, and provide white-glove support to executives and employees in the office, remote support for our remote-first workforce, and live support for meetings and onsite events. The pace is fast, with frequent walk-ups and interruptions, and you will work as part of a 24x7 global IT team.


We're looking for an energetic, pragmatic people-person who is collaborative and hands-on, comfortable working at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and customer support, and eager to help modernize how IT runs.


What you'll work on:


  • Provide white-glove support for software, hardware, and network issues to on-site executives, employees, traveling teams, and visiting customers. Diagnose problems, guide the fix, and keep the office running.
  • Provide remote support to employees working outside the office in a remote-first company.
  • Log, assign, track, and verify incidents and service requests through resolution in the ticketing system, including computers, printers, and requests from internal application teams.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain MacBooks and peripherals, and manage them through Iru (MDM).
  • Maintain the office network, including Cisco Meraki equipment, firewalls, managed switches, VLANs, and routers.
  • Support audio-visual systems across the office: conference rooms (Zoom, Google Meet), presentation boards, and displays.
  • Operate and troubleshoot live audio, camera, and display equipment during large presentations and events, including occasional evening events.
  • Manage and troubleshoot office security systems, including facial recognition, security cameras, and card readers.
  • Support IT business continuity and disaster recovery for the office: planning, documentation, testing, and recovery readiness. Participate in semiannual disaster recovery tests; verify replication, redundancy, backups, and archiving; identify gaps; and restore servers, networks, and applications. 
  • Partner with the cybersecurity team to enforce security policies, manage network access, monitor for suspicious activity and vulnerabilities, and help respond to and remediate incidents.
  • Use AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, debugging, and routine work.
  • Keep runbooks current, including escalation paths.

What you'll bring to Circle:


  • Ability to work onsite at the New York City office, Monday through Friday, full-time, with occasional after-hours support for events.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering macOS systems, MacBooks, and related peripherals, including MDM (Iru, Workspace ONE), core enterprise SaaS and IT systems (Google Workspace, Slack, Okta), and network troubleshooting.
  • 3+ years in a customer-facing support role, including white-glove technical support for executives or senior staff.
  • Experience working tickets in ServiceNow or a similar ticketing system.
  • Hands-on networking experience with Cisco Meraki, firewalls, managed switches, VLANs, and routers.
  • Experience with conference room systems and A/V installations, including Zoom Rooms or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting business continuity and disaster recovery, including plan testing, backup and recovery, and restoring systems after a disruption.
  • Experience working with a security team on access control, monitoring, vulnerability management, firewalls, and incident response.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline work, troubleshooting, and debugging.
  • Experience administering Linux and Windows Server is a plus.
  • Ability to code in Golang, Python, or shell is a plus.
  • Experience with Terraform and Ansible is a plus.
  • Experience running live audio-video for large events is a plus.
